From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@brightline.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation MAP + Cutover blackout windows — ownership and clarifications

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for the time earlier. As requested, attaching a working copy of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a separate PDF that lists the cutover / maintenance blackout windows you flagged in the discovery call.

Two asks to keep us moving:
1) Can you confirm the three blackout dates that must be avoided for production traffic (highlighted on page 2 of the PDF)?
2) Please confirm the BrightLine owners for the infra and SSO items (we have them listed as Alex G. and Samantha L. but want to be sure).

Deliverables we will own and their interim owners:
- Sandbox provisioning (Redwood) — Irene Choi
- Integration test plan and run (joint) — Ben Carter (Redwood) + BrightLine QA
- Data retention and logs acceptance (BrightLine) — Alex Green

I attached: BrightLine_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (working MAP) and cutover_blackout_windows.pdf. I put a HubSpot link to the MAP as well if you prefer to comment inline.

If those owners and blackout dates look right I’ll update the MAP and loop Legal for procurement timing.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: BrightLine_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 68KB)
Attachment: cutover_blackout_windows.pdf (PDF, 72KB)
From: Alex Green <alex.green@brightline.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@brightline.com>, BrightLine IT Ops <it-ops@brightline.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 14:09:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Implementation MAP + Cutover blackout windows — ownership and clarifications

Jordan —

Appreciate the MAP. Quick answers:
- Blackout windows (production): Oct 24-26 (major holiday promo), Nov 27-30 (Black Friday weekend), and Dec 18-20 (year-end inventory). Those dates are hard constraints.
- Owners: I own SSO/infra approvals, Samantha will own the data retention and logs acceptance.

One more constraint: our security team requires a list of RW API endpoints and expected token TTLs before we start sandbox provisioning. Can you have that to us by next Wednesday (9/10)?

Thanks,
Alex Green
Director of Platform
BrightLine Retail
alex.green@brightline.com

Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Implementation MAP + Cutover blackout windows — ownership and clarifications

Team —

Thanks Alex for the quick confirmation. I summarized below and added a few action items to the MAP so we have single-source accountability. I’ll upload a marked copy to the Drive link Jordan shared.

Summary (as of 9/08):
- Blackout dates (BrightLine): 2025-10-24 -> 2025-10-26, 2025-11-27 -> 2025-11-30, 2025-12-18 -> 2025-12-20 (BrightLine will not accept production deploys during these windows).
- Infra/SSO owner: Alex Green (BrightLine).
- Data retention / logs acceptance owner: Samantha Li (BrightLine).
- Sandbox provisioning owner (Redwood): Irene Choi — target 9/17
- Integration test run owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) & BrightLine QA — target 10/05

Action items I added to the MAP (row refs in spreadsheet):
- Row 7: Add endpoint list & token TTLs -> Owner: Jordan Blake -> Due: 2025-09-10
- Row 12: Legal review procurement timeline -> Owner: Marissa Cole -> Due: 2025-09-18
- Row 19: Schedule smoke test during non-blackout window -> Owner: Irene Choi / BrightLine QA -> Due: 2025-09-22

Notes / risks:
- If endpoint/token details slip past 9/10 we will miss the sandbox provisioning target (9/17). I flagged this as a moderate risk in the MAP.
- There is a required SOC2 evidence packet that BrightLine’s security team asked for. Jordan — please coordinate with Security to provide the standard packet; I’ll put Legal on a 1:1 with BrightLine if any custom attestation is needed.

Irene — can you confirm provisioning ETA and whether you need any additional infra contacts from BrightLine?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: BrightLine_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (updated notes, 72KB)

Alex —

Attached inline below is the endpoint summary and token TTLs the security team asked for (also uploaded to the Drive link). High-level:
- API endpoints: api.redwood.com/v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/session
- Token TTLs we recommend: 1 hour for session tokens; 30 days for service tokens (rotate keys quarterly)

Irene is standing up the sandbox tomorrow; ETA remains 9/17. Irene — please confirm once provisioning completes and paste the sandbox URL in the MAP.

Once Alex confirms the token details are sufficient we’ll kick the integration test plan and set a smoke test date outside the blackout windows.

Thanks,
Jordan
